title: The streak that doesn't count
hints: Streaks in the middle of the week work. Try one that runs right up to the last day, e.g. `{1000, 9000, 9000}` with goal 8000, and trace `current` and `longest` by hand.
`longest` is only updated when a streak is broken by a missed day. A streak that is still going when the loop ends is never compared with `longest`.
After the loop, the running streak still needs one last comparison: `return current > longest ? current : longest;`.
